identitySignals: Agenda names 'The Regents of the University of California' with the unit 'CREED, National Board Resource Center' in Berkeley, CA; the UC Berkeley School of Education hosts a National Board Resource Center (under CREEO, the Center for Research on Expanding Educational Opportunity)
The National Board Resource Center page describes support for teachers pursuing National Board Certification, matching the contract title 'National Board Certification Teacher Support'
UC Berkeley's National Board Resource Center pages mention working with Oakland Unified School District (OUSD) teachers and principals
The University of California is governed by the Board of Regents, matching the legal contracting party name
research.notes: The contracting entity is The Regents of the University of California, the governing body of the UC system; the profile describes the UC system, with contact details for the Office of the Secretary and Chief of Staff to the Regents (Oakland). The program that OUSD contracts with is the National Board Resource Center at UC Berkeley's School of Education (Berkeley, CA). Legal name, EIN, CA entity number and UEI left null because not verified on a cited page.

profile.summary: The University of California is a public research university system with 10 campuses, including UC Berkeley, plus academic health centers, health professional schools and national laboratories. It is governed by the Board of Regents. The contract is with a UC Berkeley School of Education unit, the National Board Resource Center, which supports teachers pursuing National Board Certification.

The summary is neutral and supported; the contact email is a generic office address, not an individual's.
